dialogues.speaker: Amir
dialogues.text: Oh... She's a Trainee Forest Ranger with us.

dialogues.speaker: Amir
dialogues.text: She... is in poor health, so she's here to learn and recuperate at the same time.

dialogues.speaker: Amir
dialogues.text: She's so young yet so eager to excel. I'm still quite worried about her condition.

dialogues.speaker: Amir
dialogues.text: That's why I asked the search and rescue dogs to pay attention to her condition and notify me immediately if something happens. That's the only way I can be there in time to help her.
